items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: We used to play together at the theatre. What? The Laird theatre. Robichaux. With John Robichaux.

ctx.x: Were there other good drummers around at that time? No.

Oh, yes. They had... Let me see, what's his name again? I just mentioned... Oh, dear. Oh, Lord. He used to play with us. Murray. Oh, yes. Charlie Murray. Charlie? Murray. Johnny. Johnny. Johnny Murray. Was that the brother of the other... No, Murray. Murray. Murray. Murray. Oh, I can't make sure. Was his name Murray or Mac Murray or... Yes, Mac Murray. Mac Murray. Murray, yes. Murray. Murray. That was another good drum. Did you know Happy Chandler? Happy was good, too. Is he good? Yes. We used to play together at…

Did they ever use any instruments that are not used anymore now, before? Now they usually just have a trumpet, trombone, and clarinet for horns. Occasionally saxophone. Were there other horns that were specialties of the old bands?
